memory_candidates.content: In this agent-system deployment model, a 'deploy consumer' repo's own .claude/scripts/tests/run-all.sh and verify-deploy.sh SKIP every source-store-specific gate (doc-lint, manifest-driven parity, agent-contracts lint, run-all.sh itself, etc.) with '[SKIP] ... is a deploy consumer, not the source store'. To actually exercise those gates (or a specific shell-test suite under agent-system/extensions/<ext>/scripts/tests/), resolve the extension's source_dir from <project-root>/.claude-extensions.json and run verify-deploy.sh/run-all.sh FROM that source-store repo root, not from the deploy-consumer repo's deployed .claude/ tree. The source-store repo may have its OWN separate deployed .claude/ tree that also needs its own `deploy-headless.sh` redeploy after any source edit -- redeploying the consumer repo does not update it.

update-phase-status.sh's heading-status replacement (sed -i "${line_number}s/\[.*\]/[${new_status_display}]/") uses an unanchored, greedy bracket match. If a phase title itself embeds a bracket-wrapped literal (e.g. a phase named '... `[file-scope]` notice ...'), the greedy match spans from that title bracket all the way to the trailing status bracket and overwrites everything in between, corrupting the heading. Workaround: after calling update-phase-status.sh on such a phase, immediately verify the heading via grep and repair it with Edit if corrupted -- the script's heartbeat side effect still fires correctly even though the heading text needs a manual fix.
